documents.text:
# Privacy Policy

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Applies when the free NFL friends beta is activated; it does not change earlier consent records.

Docked is operated by Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd, ABN 78 606 187 106. Contact support@docked.com.au for support, moderation, access, correction, account closure or a privacy complaint.

## Information and purposes

The free beta is invitation-only for the owner and at most ten Australian adults. We collect your account email and identifiers, profile, country/state and age attestations, consent versions, preferences, authentication/security records, cards and ownership history, teams, competition entries, scores and community activity. You provide account and community information; the service generates gameplay and security records. We use these to run the game, protect accounts and finite inventory, moderate content, handle requests and record consent. Required account and eligibility information is needed to participate; optional profile content is your choice.

Profiles, posts and competition information follow the app's visibility and blocking controls. Reports, private preferences and security records are not public posts. Do not submit passwords, verification links, identity documents, payment-card details or other unnecessary sensitive information to support. Payments, prizes, cash trading, withdrawals and identity-document collection are disabled. Ordinary members do not need mandatory MFA; administrators do.

## Providers and locations

We use Supabase for authentication and the database configured in Sydney, Vercel for web hosting with Sydney functions, and Microsoft Exchange Online for support and account email. The mailbox was purchased through GoDaddy, which also lists Advanced Email Security. Providers may use overseas infrastructure, support and subprocessors. Supabase's published residency guidance identifies additional support/service processing in the United States, Singapore and Europe; these are not the only possible locations across all providers. Sydney configuration does not mean all processing stays in Australia.

We have not verified this mailbox's data-at-rest geography or every provider recovery, security-quarantine, backup or hold setting. We do not promise Australian-only processing or a fixed date when every provider-held copy is erased. We will update this notice when material location or preservation information is confirmed. Necessary information may also be disclosed to authorised service/support personnel, advisers or authorities where required to handle a request, incident or applicable obligation.

## Access, closure and retention

Contact support for an account-related export, correction or closure. We verify requests proportionately without routinely collecting identity documents. A support-assisted export covers available account/gameplay records and selected support correspondence; the self-service export may not contain every historical record. We explain any restriction needed to protect another person or satisfy an applicable obligation.

On verified closure we revoke beta access immediately. We aim to remove eligible account/contact details and posts/media within 30 days. Ongoing competitions, disputes and documented incidents can require limited records for longer; we explain the reason and review date. We remove account-to-game identity links within 30 days after relevant rounds/disputes close. Remaining minimised ownership/scoring evidence is reviewed at beta end and deleted or further de-identified within 12 months of beta closure unless a documented exception remains. Still-linkable records are not described as anonymous. Permanent supply and scoring integrity do not justify keeping names or email addresses indefinitely.

Routine support cases are scheduled for removal from the active mailbox 12 months after closure. Exported working copies are removed after delivery verification, within seven days. Routine operational-log retention has a maximum target of 30 days and security logs 90 days; some provider logs expire sooner. Exceptional incident/dispute evidence requires a recorded reason and review at least every 90 days. These periods describe Docked's handling of records it controls, not verified automatic expiry for every provider copy.

Recovery, quarantine, backup and applicable holds may preserve copies after active deletion. We investigate relevant restrictions for each request, explain known limitations, restrict unnecessary continued use and reapply completed deletion requests before restored data returns to active use. We do not promise immediate or guaranteed complete provider erasure within the active-record targets above.

## Support and complaints

The owner operates support/moderation, checks the inbox daily, aims to acknowledge routine requests within two business days and resolve routine privacy requests within 30 days. If more time is needed, we explain why and provide an update. Ask for review of a disputed response; we use another reviewer where practicable. Urgent safety/security reports receive prompt containment and review. Contact emergency services for immediate danger. Suspected breaches are escalated for specialist assessment where needed.

Where the Privacy Act applies, a dissatisfied person may seek assistance from the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/privacy-complaints. This notice does not restrict rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Optional marketing remains disabled and no historical storefront mailing list is imported into the beta.

# Terms of Use

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Effective with free NFL friends-beta activation.

Docked is operated by Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd, ABN 78 606 187 106; support@docked.com.au. The beta is free, invitation-only, Australia-only and 18+, limited to ten invited testers plus the owner. Public registration is closed. Verify your email, complete eligibility attestations and accept the current terms and privacy notice before gameplay.

Cards are digital game records, not investments, NFTs or deposits. Beta cards and points have no monetary value, cash redemption or permitted sale. Paid packs, payments, cash trading, prizes and withdrawals are disabled. Managing an owned-card lineup and permitted card-for-card beta swaps are free. Rarity never multiplies match scores.

NFL is initially supported with post-game scoring; EPL is unavailable until verified. Missing statistics stay pending, provisional results can be corrected and finalisation requires complete evidence. This experimental beta can have outages and incomplete features. It does not promise uninterrupted availability or particular player performance.

Do not share accounts, impersonate others, evade admission limits, automate reward farming, manipulate results or exploit errors. Keep credentials and verification links private. The server enforces ownership, eligibility and deadlines. Corrections and transfers preserve audit history and cannot rewrite earlier locked lineups or replenish lifetime issuance capacity.

Beta inventory and competitions are isolated from commercial inventory and do not automatically become future commercial assets. Existing historical fictional cards are preserved separately, not silently relabelled as real-player cards. Access may be restricted for abuse or security, with an explanation/review available through support. Closure is handled under the Privacy Policy and does not recycle a consumed tester slot or starter entitlement. Nothing excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Material rule/term changes are communicated before application; locked competition versions are preserved.

# Free Beta Participation

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Effective with free NFL friends-beta activation.

The beta admits only the owner and at most ten invited Australian adults aged 18+. Invitations are email-bound, expiring and single-use. The owner authorises recipients individually; public self-registration is closed. Ordinary members are not required to enrol in MFA; owner/admin access requires MFA.

NFL cards, teams, free card swaps and post-game scoring are the initial scope. EPL is unavailable. Beta cards and points have no monetary value. Payments, paid packs, cash trading, prizes, withdrawals and identity-document collection are disabled. Do not sell or share accounts or invitations.

Historical acceptance competitions and simulations are isolated and labelled; they are not genuine member results. Beta records do not automatically transfer to a future commercial product. Report defects, content or access concerns to support@docked.com.au. Device testing and service reliability may still reveal beta limitations; no uninterrupted service is promised.

# Community Guidelines

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Effective with free NFL friends-beta activation.

Be respectful. Do not post harassment, threats, hate, exploitation, pornography, graphic violence, encouragement of self-harm, scams, illegal material, impersonation or private information without permission. Share only content you have permission to use. Do not promote paid sales, gambling, external reward-farming services or cash redemption of beta cards, points or accounts. Do not manipulate scores or encourage security exploits.

Use report, block and mute controls. Reports and private preferences are not public posts. Uploaded images are subject to moderation. The owner may restrict content or accounts with an audited reason. Request review through support@docked.com.au without reposting harmful material. Include your username, relevant dates and the outcome sought, not passwords, verification links or identity documents.

The owner checks support daily, aims to acknowledge routine requests within two business days and resolve routine privacy/complaint requests within 30 days, explaining delays. Another reviewer is used where practicable. Urgent security/safety reports receive prompt containment and review; continuous moderation is not promised. For immediate danger, contact emergency services. Suspected data breaches or applicable reporting obligations are escalated for specialist assessment. Applicable rights are not limited by this procedure.

documents.title: Fantasy Card Rules
documents.text:
# Fantasy Card Rules

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Effective with free NFL friends-beta activation.

All current NFL players are eligible under the beta catalogue rules, with supported playable positions and verified mappings required for allocation. The server allocates a valid starter collection of ten distinct players: two quarterbacks, three running backs, three wide receivers and two tight ends. Allocation is free, audited and idempotent; retrying does not issue another entitlement. Availability is checked before issuing cards. No first-year-only rule applies to this isolated free beta.

Beta inventory is separate from permanent commercial editions. Existing fictional cards/history are retained separately, never silently renamed. Each card retains its identity, edition, serial and ownership provenance. Transfers cannot replenish lifetime issuance capacity. Rarity has no effect on match points.

Permitted card-for-card beta swaps are free. The server checks both owners and eligibility, transfers atomically and rejects stale, cancelled, expired or competing offers. Cash sales and paid fees are disabled. Transfers do not rewrite locked lineup snapshots or earned points, and the implemented locked-card restrictions apply. A card does not guarantee eligibility in every future competition.

Cards, engagement points and beta rewards have no monetary value or cash redemption. Any supported engagement reward is separate from sporting scores. The current NFL allocation/scoring rules, not historical fictional reward configurations, govern this beta. Contact support@docked.com.au for missing allocations or ownership concerns.

documents.title: Competition and Points Rules
documents.text:
# Competition and Points Rules

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Effective with free NFL friends-beta activation.

NFL teams use seven distinct eligible owned players: one QB, two RB, two WR, one TE and one FLEX from RB/WR/TE. The server enforces positions, ownership and the displayed whole-round deadline. No full round opens after its first fixture has started. The displayed deadline uses local time; the server clock is authoritative.

Each competition records its scoring/rules version and locks a lineup snapshot. Later transfers or lineup edits cannot alter that snapshot or previously earned points. Match points are equal across card tiers. No captain, rarity, level, price or spend multiplier applies. Engagement points are separate and never added to sporting scores.

The scoring tables at /fantasy/scoring are generated from Docked's versioned engine. NFL uses post-game source statistics, not live fantasy totals. Collection begins no earlier than six hours after Docked first observes a reliable completed-game marker; that observation time is not an exact final-whistle timestamp. Low-frequency schedules and source availability can delay scores further.

Missing or ambiguous required fields remain awaiting results/pending or disputed, never invented final zeroes. Provisional totals may change after source correction. Final standings require required results to be complete and finalised; unresolved ties are shown without inventing a winner. Append-only revisions preserve correction history. There are no entry fees or prizes. Historical acceptance fixtures remain separate from genuine member competitions.

# Healthy Participation

Version 2026-10-11-beta-rc3. Effective with free NFL friends-beta activation. The historical internal document identifier is retained solely for consent-record compatibility.

Docked's current product is a fantasy sports card game. It does not accept bets, money, deposits or withdrawals. Beta cards and points have no monetary value or redemption. Paid packs, cash trading and prizes are disabled. Participation is restricted to invited Australian adults aged 18+.

Take breaks and use notifications conservatively. Do not promote gambling, paid external card sales, scams or guaranteed financial returns through the community. Contact support@docked.com.au for account closure, moderation or participation concerns. For immediate danger, contact emergency services.
